input.summary: V05 Nilagiri Phytolabs LLP (Prakash). Quoted for RFx KPC-2026-014: Glycerin Rs118/kg; Rosemary extract 20% Rs7000/kg, MOQ 100 kg, 12-month shelf life; Caffeine Rs1650/kg only if one full lot (size unstated). Freight extra ~Rs9/kg. Terms: 50% advance, 49% on delivery; 3-week delivery. Claims 99% OTIF and zero rejection, no data supplied. Certificates under renewal; offers COA only after order, which conflicts with our need for COA before award. Two clarification emails and one reminder sent; no reply by the 14 Nov 2026 deadline (no_reply). Open: RM-002 MOQ and shelf life; RM-005 lot size in kg and shelf life; knockouts H1 (SDS), B5 (COA), H2 (cosmetic suitability). Sending a final firm request; if still silent, close out and escalate the knockout gaps to buyer.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: Final request, reply required
input.body:
Dear Prakash,

We have had no reply to our clarification requests for RFx KPC-2026-014, and the response deadline of 14 November 2026 has passed. This is our final request. Please reply by return with the following:

Quote clarifications:
1. Glycerin (RM-002): state the minimum order quantity in kg and the order multiple.
2. Glycerin (RM-002): state the total shelf life from date of manufacture, and the minimum remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.
3. Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005): state the lot size in kg that "one full lot" refers to.
4. Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005): state the total shelf life from date of manufacture, and the minimum remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.

Mandatory compliance documents (required for Glycerin, Rosemary leaf extract and Caffeine anhydrous):
5. Current Safety Data Sheet for each line, including transport hazard class.
6. Certificate of Analysis from a recent batch for each line, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date. We need the COA before award, not after order.
7. Confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp cosmetic use and permitted under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

If we do not receive these by the date set in our next communication, we will be unable to take your quotation further for this RFx.

Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
